scope: Read-only introductory embedded lesson using actual application source; no code edits or device actions.
verified: Application entry is core0_main; initialization precedes the forever foreground loop.
Foreground calls vision_process_pending, vision_debug_poll and vision_screen_poll; it also handles launch keys/state and wireless.
Timer CCU60_CH0 requests 5 ms direction-loop scheduling; CCU60_CH1 requests 2 ms angle/speed scheduling.
clock_init implementation obtains current clocks, initializes delays and configures interrupt/watchdog state; it is not described as raising CPU frequency.
Separate hardware-test source uses actual elapsed time rather than a guaranteed exact 10 ms tick.
